verdict.rationale: GlitchTip receives events from Sentry's open-source SDKs and aims for Sentry API compatibility. Its CLI uploads native debug symbols (dSYM, PDB, ELF), which implies native crash symbolication for iOS and Android/NDK builds. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents mobile crash capture or the device, OS, and app-version context the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android/NDK crash-capture docs, documented device/OS/app-version context on events, confirmation that native symbolication works end to end, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile crash reporting.
